LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: The Snow Queen
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: The Snow Queen (F-01-37) seals repeatedly failed workers inside a crystalline ice coffin.\nSend a courageous champion to win her duel within 90 seconds to rescue the prisoner and earn the Snow Queen's frost-blossom E.G.O. Gift.
